result.title: State of Mind: Learning and Evaluating World Models of Naturalistic Brain Dynamics
result.summary: Understanding naturalistic brain activity requires going beyond the stimulus alone, as external inputs continuously interact with an individual's evolving brain state. A world model captures such dynamics in a latent state by inferring it from neural observations, predicting stimulus-driven evolution, and updating with new observations. However, existing brain world models fail to maintain a persistent latent state over time, and standard metrics of neural prediction accuracy cannot tell whether a model tracks an individual's brain state or relies solely on the stimulus. To directly test state inference, prediction, and updating, we introduce BrainStateBench, which evaluates a model's latent state through a frozen linear probe on whole-cortex, movie-driven fMRI. Its State task tests whether a model captures trial-to-trial variability in an individual's responses to repeated stimuli, while Forecast and Updating evaluate future activity predictions without and with new observations, respectively. To track individual brain state across time, we propose Spectator, a linear latent world model trained with a joint-embedding predictive objective. Spectator encodes short- and long-horizon observation histories into a two-timescale latent state and predicts state transitions linearly from the current state and stimulus. Stimulus-only encoders reach 0.320 in fMRI prediction correlation without observing the brain (0% on State), while prior deep brain world models reach 0.239 yet score at most 0.4% on State. In contrast, Spectator achieves 0.349 correlation alongside 5.5% on State, 16.0% on Forecast, and 20.3% on Updating, outperforming all baselines while forecasting over 20x faster than deep forecasting models.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Spectator：一个以联合嵌入预测目标训练的线性潜变量世界模型，用双时间尺度潜状态从 fMRI 历史推断脑状态并预测其受刺激驱动的演化；同时构建 BrainStateBench 评估状态推断、预测与更新。
AI.relevance_reason: 其持续潜状态、双时间尺度历史编码、新观测更新及用冻结线性探针区分刺激驱动与个体状态的设计，可能为 LVR 的潜伏工作区维护、视觉证据筛选和贡献归因提供方法线索，需核查线性状态转移与评估方式是否适用于视觉推理。
